name: Hochstein
kurzbeschreibung: The Hochstein (2,057 m) is the local adventure mountain of Lienz, featuring the Schlossbergbahn, Osttirodler alpine coaster, bike park, and Hochsteinhütte.
oeffnungszeiten: Mitte Mai bis Ende Okt täglich 09:00–17:00 Uhr (Juli/Aug bis 18:00 Uhr)
beschreibung:
Overview

The Hochstein is the 2,057-metre-high local mountain of the sunny town of Lienz in Osttirol and forms the sporty, family-friendly counterpart to the rugged Lienzer Dolomiten. Situated on the sunny southern slopes of the Villgratner Berge, the Lienzer Bergbahnen provide access to the mountain in three varied sections from the edge of town to just below the summit plateau. Whether thrilling rides on the year-round Osttirodler, challenging descents in the Bikepark Lienz, or enjoyable alpine pasture hikes with panoramic vistas across the entire Lienz valley basin and the Drautal – the Hochstein delights visitors of all ages.

Attractions & Leisure Activities

Tourism development began in the post-war era; today, the modern Schlossbergbahn combi-lift (8-seater gondolas and 6-seater chairs) carries guests directly from Lienz to the Moosalm at an altitude of 1,000 metres. Here beats the heart of the family offerings: a lovingly designed petting zoo, an adventurous forest high-ropes course, and sunny mountain huts welcome visitors young and old. The absolute highlight is the spectacular Osttirodler: with a track length of 2.7 kilometres, this alpine coaster ranks among the longest year-round toboggan runs in the world. On rail-guided sleds, guests zoom down steep curves, waves, and two spectacular 360-degree loops towards the valley, finishing right by Schloss Bruck. For mountaineers, the double chairlift leads up to the Sternalm (1,505 m) and onward to the historic Hochsteinhütte at 2,057 metres. Downhill mountain bikers will find challenging flow lines and singletracks in the Bikepark Lienz.

Visit & Getting There

The Schlossbergbahn and the Osttirodler operate daily during the summer season from mid-May to late October from 09:00 to 17:00 (extended to 18:00 in peak summer July/August); lift and coaster operations also run in winter. Summer 2025/2026 tariffs: Schlossbergbahn combi-ticket ascent including descent on the Osttirodler €24.50 for adults, €18.00 for children and youths (born 2008–2020), €7.00 for toddlers (aged 3–5); single Osttirodler ride €16.00 and €12.00 respectively. Mountain railway ticket covering all 3 sections up to Hochstein: adults €36.00, children €22.00. Cable car rides are included with the regional Osttirol Card. Travel by car: via the Drautalstraße B100 or Felbertauernstraße B108 to Lienz, follow signs for Schlossbergbahn; large free car park at the valley station (Iseltaler Straße 27). By public transport: ÖBB to Lienz railway station, from there take Lienz city bus line 1 or walk directly to the valley station in about 15 minutes.

Tips

The valley station and the combi-lift gondolas up to Moosalm are barrier-free; children must be at least 3 years old to ride the Osttirodler (from age 8 and 1.30 m in height they are permitted to steer independently). After the coaster fun, a short stroll to neighbouring Schloss Bruck with its art collection and castle pond is well worth it.
